CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 24.02.2026 CRL.M.A. 6128/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 485/2024 of PS Adarsh Nagar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that State has no serious objection to this petition.
4. Respondent no. 2 identified by IO/SI Rajesh Kumar also accepts notice.
